title: Sharp rupee appreciation may cut IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13%: Report
summary: According to a new report, the appreciation of the Indian rupee could lead Indian IT companies to experience reduced earnings. The stronger rupee against foreign currencies may significantly impact profitability, especially for firms with substantial European exposure. As traditional cost-saving strategies grow scarce, maintaining margins will be a challenge, compounded by the current economic environment affecting pricing strategies in the industry.

title: Sebi plans consultation paper to remove FPI constraints absent in other markets
summary: SEBI is set to release a consultation paper aimed at simplifying regulations for foreign portfolio investors. The goal is to eliminate certain compliance restrictions to enhance India's appeal to global investors. SEBI also plans to expedite the onboarding process, targeting completion in just five business days. Additionally, KYC review cycles for applicable FPIs will be extended, reducing repetitive compliance activities.

title: Indian finance hub eyes dual share model to kickstart public offers: Report
summary: Indian regulators are currently assessing a new proposal that would allow companies to introduce dual-class shares for listings in both domestic markets and GIFT City. This initiative seeks to invigorate equity market activity in GIFT City, which has faced challenges regarding limited primary market participation. One class of shares would be traded in rupees, while the other would be dollar-denominated, granting foreign investors easier access alongside reduced tax implications.

title: Rupee rises past 93 vs USD as portfolio inflows, bear retreat fuel rally
summary: The Indian rupee has shown remarkable strength, breaking the 93 per dollar barrier for the first time since April. This positive shift was fueled by impressive foreign portfolio investments, exceeding $12 billion in November alone.
